linkage_notes: T1520I is only ever observed alongside F1534C, in both India and Taiwan.
D1763Y is only ever observed alongside V1016G.
S989P is only ever observed alongside V1016G.
India found no recombination among the V1016G, F1534L and F1534C haplogroups.
L982W, A1007G and I1011M were not detected at all in the Taiwanese survey.
